about_the_game:
One Last Toast is a first-person adventure set in a Venetian villa owned by the Bepi's family.

You awaken in the chilling silence of a ballroom, surrounded by the deceased guests of the family's latest celebration. Just hours ago, you raised a glass to their new wine.

Now, the opulent Venetian villa is a tomb, strangled by monstrous vines visible beyond the windows, and haunted by a sinister force within its walls.

As perhaps the only survivor, your primary goal is to make it out alive.

Explore, Fight, Survive

  • Explore and find your way through the handcrafted Villa hallways, in an attempt to reach its very core.

  • Find the items you need to progress through the estate’s locked doors and hidden passages.

  • Battle nightmarish creatures with scavenged weapons, from melee to firearms.

  • Feel the impact of every hit with dynamic, physics-based reactions.

  • Survive: ammo is scarce and bullets should not be wasted.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580

short_description: One Last Toast is a single player retro-inspired action horror game set in a Venetian villa. Explore the intricate interiors, solve puzzles and battle relentless zombie hordes to reach the heart of the curse trapping you in this haunted estate.
